BiblicalUsage: Sheva — spelled here with a yod where the other spelling has a vav — is the scribe in the days of David, named beside Zadok and Abiathar the priests. The same verse carries the name in both spellings, and this row is the scribe.
TheologicalSignificance: A scribe's name deserves its place, because the man who kept the king's records kept the history I read.
